Method of Attack: Improper usage of shared memory allowing read and write access
Sending a specially crafted request to exploit shared memory vulnerability
Writing incorrect data over target memory area to cause denial of service
Discoverer: Martin Rakhmanov, Security Research Manager, SpiderLabs at Trustwave
Impacted Systems: IBM Db2 relational database versions 9.7, 10.1, 10.5, 11.1, 11.5 for Linux, UNIX, and Windows
Attack Vector: Local attacker accessing shared memory without explicit protections
Indicators of Compromise: Missing access protections on shared memory used by Db2 trace facility
